title: Little Blue Truck
author: Alice Schertle

hero.name: Little Blue Truck
hero.description: Small cheerful blue pickup truck with a friendly face, as illustrated by Jill McElmurry
hero.source_note: Named/distinctive character with face — generic Boardmaker truck won't match; source from Creative Fabrica, TPT, or Teachers Pay Teachers clip art

ambiguous.issue: Could mean the bird (noun) or to duck/dodge (verb)
ambiguous.reason: In this book duck is a farm animal character who helps push the truck

notes: All 11 fringe words exist in either activity_images/ or aac_extras already (truck, cow, goat, duck, sheep, pig, mud, fence, barn from activity_images; beep, help, stuck, push from aac_extras) — no new icon sourcing needed beyond the hero image. 'fence' and 'toad' from existing activity_images were deprioritised in favour of the most-used farm animals and core action words (beep, stuck, push) which are central to the story's repeated refrain. 'toad' could be swapped in for 'goat' or 'sheep' if the teacher prefers to highlight that character.
